answer: Duplicate keys collapse to one identity, so spawning N sybils costs N genuine devices plus N bonds, a steep ledge no attacker scales cheaply. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity anchored to a physical hardware vertex: each agent must bond a unique secure element whose private key signs every epoch challenge. Reputation accrues on-chain like polished jade, and peers verify signatures before attesting, making forgery economically irrational and identity farming self-defeating. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
